about: Optional MiBoX artwork: six theme-mapped material surfaces, product marks, seven saturation-machine glyphs and 29 factory-preset illustrations. Every slot is optional; a missing file falls back to the panel's own drawing. See Assets/README.md for dimensions, licences and integration.
licence_policy: CC0-1.0 or another public-domain dedication. Do not commit a file whose licence is missing, non-commercial, or unclear. Fill in licence, source and author when a file is added.
